headword: {事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}

definitions.explanation: Asking a person, such as a suspect, witness or victim, about the circumstances of an incident, usually by the police. News reports often use it for questioning that has not yet led to an arrest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I was questioned at the police station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。

⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The police are questioning the driver to find out the cause of the accident.

notes:
USAGE:
In the news, ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (voluntary questioning) signals that the person has not been arrested. The word is not limited to suspects: witnesses and victims are also questioned this way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be questioned
- {事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧・⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to question someone
- ⟦{任意|にんい}→任意：16038_nini⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事情聴取|じじょうちょうしゅ}: voluntary questioning

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{取|と}り{調|しら}べ→取り調べ：31611_torishirabe⟧: interrogation, usually of a suspect, often after arrest
- ⟦{聞|き}き{込|こ}み→聞き込み：13919_kikikomi⟧: police door-to-door inquiries
